QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_44

question.text: For Cat III AIFs, the close-ended fund tenure extension under SEBI Regulations can be for UP TO:

answer.text: 5 years (applies only to LVF-AI; standard is 2 years)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation 13(4) permits a close-ended AIF to extend fund tenure by up to 2 years after seeking approval of 2/3 of unit holders by value. HOWEVER, Large-Value-Funds-for-Accredited-Investors (LVF-AI) may extend up to 5 years (Fourth Amendment 2024). Option D captures the full nuance. **The Trap:** Option B (2 years) is the default answer but misses the LVF-AI 5-year amendment. Options A and C are wrong outright. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D test the same tenure-extension rule. Fourth Amendment 2024 introduced the LVF-AI 5-year special case. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For LVF-AI schemes, plan tenure runway with the 5-year extension option in mind — it buys PM flexibility for vintage illiquid positions. Still needs 2/3 by value of unit holders.
